name: Arjun Verma
bio: Arjun discovered his passion for motorsport while working at a street food stall near the Buddh International Circuit during the Indian Grand Prix. Witnessing the energy and precision of the teams fueled a desire to contribute, leading him to pursue culinary studies with a focus on high-performance nutrition. He joined Tony Kart Racing two years ago, transforming their catering from basic sustenance to a strategic element of team performance. Arjun believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, meticulously planning menus to optimize energy levels, focus, and recovery for the drivers and crew. His innovative approach to dietary needs and his commitment to sourcing fresh, local ingredients set him apart in the competitive world of motorsport catering.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave at the front
physical.description: Arjun is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on starting every day with a cup of masala chai, brewed precisely to his specifications.
Keeps a detailed spreadsheet tracking each team member's dietary preferences and nutritional needs.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down new recipe ideas and ingredient combinations.
